pubchem.title: P-Cymene
pubchem.description: P-cymene is a monoterpene that is toluene substituted by an isopropyl group at position 4. It has a role as a volatile oil component, a plant metabolite and a human urinary metabolite. It is a member of toluenes and a monoterpene.
